source_observation: Pinned gemma4.cpp creates duplicated output from token_embd before creating tok_embd. Loader duplicate reuse only checks already-created tensors. Same CPU buffer context then creates a second token_embd allocation. Candidate cause of model buffer exceeding file payload; confirm with later value-preserving patch and allocation comparison, no speedup claim.

actual_mmap_observation.decision: Mmap already maps the original payload without a second360MiB allocation. Reordering is a read-layout-only candidate; no current mmap RAM/speed benefit established, so do not add an unneeded patch to the selected mmap profile.
